units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 31:34">Targ. Gen. XXXI, 34</cite> (h. text <cite ref="K01071"><he>כַּר</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 10:6:2">Y. B. Kam. X, end 7ᶜ</cite> <he>יכיל מימר ליה את שרי עֲבִיטָיךְ מיני</he> he (who has been forced to pay his neighbor’s arrear taxes) can say to him, take thy saddle off me, i.e. pay me the amount you would have had to pay the government. Bab.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 115a:2-14">B. Kam. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>א״ל … זיל שרי עביטך</he> he said to that man (whose stolen goods had been bought in good faith), go, untie thy saddle, i.e. redeem thy goods by indemnifying the buyer.
